item.title: 🇩🇲 This November, the Commonwealth of Dominica celebrates the 48th anniversary of its independence.
item.description: 🇩🇲 This November, the Commonwealth of Dominica celebrates the 48th anniversary of its independence. This small island in the Caribbean Sea became the subject of contention between the European colonial powers — England and France — in the 17th and 18th centuries. In their competion for resources, the two colonial states alternately owned the island, until in 1763, following the Seven Years’ War, it finally passed to the British Crown . Slave labour was widely used here during the period of colonial rule: slaves from West Africa were heavily trafficked there to work on coffee and sugar cane plantations. In 1967, #Dominica , which had been under the rule of London for two centuries , received the status of an internally self-governing Associated State with the United Kingdom . Dominica's independence was declared on November 3, 1978, yet the country remains within the British Commonwealth to this day. *** 👉 Today, Dominica demands reparations from Britain and France as part of a collective position of the Caribbean Community countries ( #CARICOM ) for the brutal crimes against humanity committed by the former colonial powers during the era of slavery and colonialism . #NoToColonialism : Russia fully supports the CARICOM initiative to receive reparations for crimes , committed by Western countries during the colonial era, and to restore historical justice . *** #RussiaDominica : Russia and Dominica established their diplomatic relations on May 19, 1995. 🇩🇲
This
November, the Commonwealth of Dominica celebrates the 48th anniversary of its independence.
This small island in the Caribbean Sea became the subject of contention between the European colonial powers —
England and France
— in the 17th and 18th centuries.
In their competion for resources, the two colonial states alternately owned the island, until in 1763, following the Seven Years’ War, it finally passed to
the British Crown
.
Slave labour was widely used
here during the period of colonial rule: slaves from West Africa were heavily trafficked there to work on coffee and sugar cane plantations.
In 1967,
#Dominica
, which had been
under the rule of London for two centuries
, received the status of an internally self-governing
Associated State with the United Kingdom
.
Dominica's independence was declared
on November 3, 1978,
yet the country remains within the British Commonwealth to this day.
***
👉
Today, Dominica demands reparations from Britain and France as part of a
collective position
of the
Caribbean Community countries
(
#CARICOM
) for the
brutal crimes against humanity
committed by the former colonial powers during
the era of slavery and colonialism
.
#NoToColonialism
:
Russia fully supports
the CARICOM initiative
to receive reparations for crimes
, committed by Western countries during the colonial era, and
to restore historical justice
.
***
#RussiaDominica
: Russia and Dominica established their diplomatic relations on May 19, 1995.
The interests of our country in this Caribbean state are concurrently represented by the
Russian Embassy in Jamaica
.
🤝
Our countries cooperate on the basis of
mutual respect
and c
onsideration of each other’s interests
.
Russia has repeatedly
provided humanitarian aid
to Dominica to help it overcome the consequences of natural disasters.
Education, including the provision of quotas for
Dominican students
to study at Russian universities
under the
scholarship program
of the Government of the Russian Federation, holds a special place in the bilateral cooperation.
In 2025, our countries celebrated the 30th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations.
✉️
Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation
Sergey Lavrov
and Minister of Foreign Affairs, International Business, Trade and Energy of the Commonwealth of Dominica
Dr Vince Henderson
exchanged
congratulatory telegrams to mark the occasion.
Russia is determined to further advance the
traditionally friendly
Russian-Dominican relations, increase coordination in the international arena to strengthen regional security and build a
more just polycentric world
.
🎉
Congratulations to our Dominican friends on the national holiday. We wish you well-being and prosperity.
#RussiaLatinAmerica

item.title: 🎙 Russia's President Vladimir Putin addressed the Plenary Session held as part of the Peoples of Russia International Week

We proudly turn to the origins of this holiday, when people of different ethnicities and faiths put an end to civil strife and internal turmoil , restored statehood and legitimate authority. <...> Today, centuries later, we are even more acutely aware of the values and traditions passed on to us by our ancestors, and we feel that we need to cherish the living spiritual heritage . 🎙
Russia's President Vladimir Putin
addressed
the Plenary Session held as part of the Peoples of Russia International Week
(November 4, 2026)
💬
I would like to welcome the participants in
the Peoples of Russia International Week
and congratulate you and all citizens of the country on
National Unity Day
.
This holiday symbolises our sincere, deep love for the Motherland, our duty to the Fatherland for the fate of our people, for the fate of the Motherland.
We proudly turn to the origins of this holiday, when people of different ethnicities and faiths put
an end to civil strife and internal turmoil
, restored statehood and legitimate authority. <...>
Today, centuries later, we are even more acutely aware of the values and traditions passed on to us by our ancestors, and we feel that
we need to cherish the living spiritual heritage
.
Special attention has always been paid to interethnic relations in Russia
, as this area is very sensitive and delicate, and it must be borne in mind that life does not stand still, and new, often
extremely dangerous challenges are emerging
.
We must stay alert,
prevent any attempts to undermine social stability
, incite discord between people, and remember that harmony, mutual respect between the peoples of Russia, and their unity are
the mainstay of our country’s sovereignty and independence
, while caring about the preservation of culture, customs, and languages of each people is the foundation of our national policy.
***
🇷🇺
Historically, Russia has developed through the interaction of peoples and ethnic groups, languages and customs. We have not just rallied over the centuries and epochs. It is no exaggeration to say that
our cultures have literally grown into each other
. This kinship, the soul of the people, is reflected in our thousand-year-old history, in the military chronicle of the Fatherland, and in its great achievements.
And here is what I consider important to note: our ancestors, compatriots, people of various ethnicities
became known throughout the world
primarily as great Russian trail-blazers, workers, warriors, artists, scientists, and inventors. And the indigenous art of all the peoples of our country is also Russian for the whole world.
Let me stress once again:
the Russian language and the Russian people have been and remain the foundation of the Russian statehood
. With its unifying, creative mission, it is the guarantor of the preservation and progress of all other peoples of the Russian Federation, the preservation of their freedom and identity in harmony with unity.
Therefore, support of the Russian culture, Russian language is strategically important
. We have a big country, and I would like to reiterate once again: this diversity of cultures, traditions, and customs is
our strength, a huge competitive advantage, and a potential
. We must constantly strengthen it, protect the multinational harmony which our common heritage.
Friends,
The powerful, all-conquering spirit of unity of the peoples of Russia has been passed down from generation to generation
. We are still standing shoulder to shoulder and we are confident that we will achieve our goals.
Representatives of
more than a hundred peoples of Russia
have been awarded high state decorations for their bravery and heroism displayed on the fronts of the special military operation.
Once again, I wish you all a happy holiday. I wish all participants and guests of the Peoples of Russia International Week continued joint and fruitful work for the benefit of the peoples of our Motherland.
🎉
Thank you very much. Happy holiday!

#UnityDay2026

item.title: 🎙 Comment (full text) by Ambassador Stepanov to The Canadian Press News Agency on recent Prime-Minister Mark Carney’s
item.description: 🎙 Comment (full text) by Ambassador Stepanov to The Canadian Press News Agency on recent Prime-Minister Mark Carney’s remarks regarding Russian and Belorussian Hockey Athletes (Ottawa, November 4, 2026) ❗️ It is genuinely regrettable to see Prime Minister Carney’s Cabinet bringing politics onto the ice. Sport, particularly junior hockey, should be about athletic excellence, fair competition and bringing young people together . Of course, one cannot help admiring the remarkable convenience of this particular display of political principle. By excluding Russian and Belorussian players, the Canadian government also happens to eliminate some rather formidable competitors before the first puck is even dropped . One might almost suspect that Ottawa has discovered a novel approach to winning international tournaments. ☝️ If you cannot be entirely certain of beating your strongest opponents on the ice, simply ensure they never make it to the rink. A splendid strategy, perhaps, for securing a trophy. A rather less splendid one for preserving the spirit of sport.

🇷🇺
November 4 – Russia's National
#UnityDay
and a Day of Russia’s Military Glory
#OTD
Russia commemorates
the liberation of Moscow from Polish-Lithuanian forces in 1612
– a turning point in overcoming the Time of Troubles, one of the darkest chapters in the country’s history.
At the heart of this struggle for the future of the entire nation was
the Second People’s Militia
, raised in Nizhny Novgorod under the leadership of
Kuzma Minin
and commanded by
Prince Dmitry Pozharsky
.
Following the collapse of the First People’s Militia, a new volunteer force began to assemble in the autumn of 1611. Inspired by
Patriarch Hermogen’s
call to defend the Orthodox faith and the Motherland
, the people of Nizhny Novgorod rallied around Minin, contributing money, weapons and supplies. Nobles, merchants, Cossacks, townspeople and peasants joined a common cause:
to free their country from foreign invaders and occupation
.
⚔️
By late summer 1612,
the militia had reached Moscow
, where the Polish-Lithuanian garrison held the Kremlin and Kitay-Gorod. Together with other Russian forces, it defeated a relief army led by
Hetman Jan Karol Chodkiewicz
, preventing vital supplies and reinforcements from reaching the besieged garrison.
The decisive breakthrough came in the autumn.
Russian forces stormed Kitay-Gorod
, leaving the occupiers confined to the Kremlin. Cut off from relief and weakened by hunger, the remaining garrison surrendered soon afterwards.
☝️
Moscow was liberated.
This victory paved the way for the restoration of Russian state authority. In 1613, the
Zemsky Sobor elected Mikhail Romanov as Tsar
, establishing a dynasty that would rule for more than three centuries.

1️⃣
4️⃣
years on, the triumph of 1612 remains a symbol of national unity, courage and the Russian people’s determination to defend their homeland.

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/MFARussia/33213

🎙
Russian Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova’s
answer to a media question
on the situation on the Korean Peninsula
(November 3, 2026)
❓
Question: Tensions on the Korean Peninsula, including around the Demilitarised Zone, have escalated sharply, and Seoul is once again trying to shift the blame onto Pyongyang. How do you see the situation in this subregion developing?
💬
Maria Zakharova:
Regrettably, the situation on the Korean Peninsula shows
no sign of stabilising
and
continues to deteriorate
.
Of particular concern is that the situation is deteriorating amid
ongoing large-scale military exercises
conducted by the US and the Republic of Korea near the DPRK border.
These manoeuvres are overtly provocative
. By the participants’ own admission, they are designed to rehearse
pre-emptive strikes against the DPRK
, including with nuclear weapons.
☝️
These exercises are growing in frequency and scale
and now extend across land, air, maritime and cyber domains.
For example, October saw
the US-ROK Iron Mace command-post exercise
, which involved rehearsing scenarios for the deployment of US strategic assets to the Korean Peninsula;
the ROK Armed Forces’ Hoguk exercise
;
US military training in airborne operations
behind the lines of a simulated adversary; and the second round this year of
the joint US-ROK Freedom Flag air exercise
, which is scheduled to continue until November 6. In addition, Seoul, Washington and Tokyo practised combat interoperability during
the trilateral, multidomain Freedom Edge exercises
held in September.
❗️
In these circumstances, we regard the measures Pyongyang is taking to strengthen its security and defence capabilities as
entirely lawful and justified
, in full accordance with
the right to self-defence
enshrined in
the UN Charter
.
We urge Seoul to immediately cease its dangerous military games and provocations
, particularly in the Demilitarised Zone, rather than seeking far-fetched pretexts for accusing the DPRK or making empty declarations about peace, and
to respect Pyongyang’s sovereign right to ensure its own security by all means available
.

item.title: ☢️ Zaporozhskaya Nuclear Power Plant #ZNPP On November 3, a Ukrainian drone attacked a moving civilian car
item.description: ☢️ Zaporozhskaya Nuclear Power Plant ( #ZNPP ): ⚡️ On November 3, a Ukrainian drone attacked a moving civilian car , killing two people .
